msg: The game is a fun one. it takes a bit long to finish but focus on the multiples and keep alternating between the two gnomes. each has their merit they come in different colours. Not sure if the colours matter but keep clicking and be on the hook. Use the instructions given at the start properly and keep on the clock and be certain. Look for the plus sign as that will give you a good hint when to press next. You can also keep a count of how many you have finished.
